title: Evolution across 50,000 generations
description: 264 sequenced clones from 12 long-term populations, summarized as the mean published substitution count for each population and sampled generation. These are counts relative to the ancestral reference, not rates.
reference: LTEE ancestor REL606 · source-defined mutation calls
unit: mean reported substitutions per sampled clone
processing: Parse first twelve tab-separated columns from count.LTEE.final_masked.csv (stored locally as ltee-count.txt). Group by population and generation; arithmetic mean of muts column across available clones. Keep clone counts and IDs. No pseudotime or genomic positions inferred.
limits: The published muts column is visualized without reclassifying mutation calls.
Counts shared by related clones are not independent mutation events.
Mean of typically two clones per population/time; no uncertainty interval inferred.
Mutator and non-mutator populations are mixed; scale and population identity matter.
